facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Urubamba river in the Sacred Valley, between Machu Picchu and Cusco.
facts.excerpt: garden oasis along the banks of the Urubamba river between Machu Picchu and Cusco

facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas are terraced into the hillside, with views across the river and garden lawns where alpacas graze freely.
facts.excerpt: our rooms, suites and villas are terraced into the hillside and feature views across the flowing river and garden lawns, where alpacas graze freely.

facts.text: Mayu Willka Spa is on the riverfront and offers wellness programs tailored to each guest.
facts.excerpt: At Mayu Willka Spa on the riverfront, bespoke wellness programs are tailored to each guest, surrounded by an enclave of wildflowers.

facts.text: The hotel has a private train station to Machu Picchu.
facts.excerpt: Private train station to Machu Picchu

facts.text: The hotel has a heated outdoor swimming pool.
The hotel hosts al fresco barbecues at El Jardin.
facts.excerpt: Al fresco BBQs at El Jardín

facts.text: The hotel is a 70 minute drive from Cusco.
The hotel is a 15 minute drive from Ollantaytambo Train Station.
facts.excerpt: 15 min drive from Ollantaytambo Train Station

facts.text: Weddings at the hotel can include a local shaman who connects the couple with the energy of Mother Earth.
facts.excerpt: a local shaman connects you and your partner with the energy of Mother Earth in the heart of the Sacred Valley.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the hotel has no TVs.
The hotel is a 5 minute drive from Urubamba Town.
The hotel says it has close ties with local Sacred Valley communities.
facts.excerpt: We have close, meaningful ties with the local communities in the Sacred Valley.
